observations.behavior: Adds a new state flag anchorWake and its clearing, alongside existing rekeyWake, to distinguish a matcher wake without an event match from a re-key wake.
observations.posthog_connection: Distinguishes two causes of waking a parked wait: re-key wake (merge) and first-mapping anchor wake, both lacking eventMatched. This prevents misattributing the outcome to the re-key counter.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that an anchorWake does not increment the poll-only advance counter.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the conditional branch handler does not treat an anchor wake as a poll-only advance, preserving the distinction between matcher-wake and poll-only behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds a check and clearing of the anchorWake flag in the conditional branch handler, mirroring the rekeyWake clearing.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the conditional branch handler to consume the anchorWake flag, clearing it after processing, similar to how rekeyWake is cleared, to avoid repeated wake handling.
